findings.problem: "Do the power first" gives no reason, so a student may not see why the squared bracket is handled before the fractions are multiplied.
findings.fix: Add a short reason to the voice, e.g. "Do the power first, because a power comes before multiplying."

findings.problem: The voice says "minus three, and plus Y", but nothing on the line is lit, so a student cannot easily see which signs flipped.
findings.fix: Light the −3 and the +y in the a-power of {t1} on those words (and the −2y and +4 in {t2} in beat 14).

findings.problem: "Add up like terms" does not show which terms combine (2 and −3 into −1; 2 and 4 into 6), so the jump from line 5 to line 6 is only heard.
findings.fix: On "Add up like terms", light the number terms in the powers on line 5 (2, −3 and 2, +4) before writing {u2} and {u4}.
